Six years later, his film "Under the Domim Tree" was screened in the Un Certain Regard section at the 1995 Cannes Film Festival.

His short by the same name (on which the feature is based) premiered at the 2007 Slamdance Film Festival and won Best International Short Film at the Lisbon Village International Digital Cinema Festival. His interactive feature film on YouTube, Hard Decisions, offers the viewer 11 possible endings.
